method.window_statistic: For F, B and paired T separately, max over per-rank sample medians
method.variant_statistic: Median of the two window maxima for each variant and scope
method.total: Recorded same-iteration F+B samples, never sum of F/B medians
method.scope: Synchronized NPU Event intervals include Host work and stream idle; not pure kernel latency
method.not_pooled: Previous always-on dtype-collective 8-of-24 pilot excluded; no carried-over windows

precision: NOT_RUN by performance jobs; finite/count smoke is not ATK precision validation
runtime_boundary: Common recorded Python/framework/system identity; CANN runtime qualification belongs to the separate environment record
